jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst
jobs.location: New York, NY or Remote USA (full-time)
jobs.why: Strong transfer in business analysis, requirements, user stories, Salesforce automation, process improvement, permissions, training, documentation, UAT, and support for a 200+ user environment. Figma's Customer Operations & Support team is improving support-system workflows, governance, and AI-enabled agent tools.
jobs.gap: This is a Zendesk-first systems administration role requiring deep hands-on Zendesk workflows, ticket routing, queue architecture, and Decagon/Zendesk integration. Audrey's Salesforce expertise is relevant but does not replace those specific platform skills. Treat as a stretch role and tailor application to system-administration transferability.

jobs.title: Sr. Salesforce Business Analyst
jobs.location: Long Island City, NY (Hybrid; up to 2 telework days/week)
jobs.why: Exceptional match to Audrey's updated resume: Salesforce requirements gathering, process mapping, workflow automation, reports/dashboards, data quality and governance, stakeholder facilitation, training, and translating operational needs into system improvements. The public-health setting also fits Audrey's interest in less-traditional corporate environments.
jobs.gap: The title is senior and the posting prefers public-health experience. It is also a temporary grant-funded position ending in November 2027. Audrey should emphasize her 200+ user Salesforce environment, Flow automation, UAT, data governance, and training impact.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.location: New York, NY (Hybrid / regular in-office presence)
jobs.why: Direct fit for Audrey's requirements gathering, user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, UAT, defect resolution, documentation, training, change management, and production-support experience. The role asks for 3-5 years supporting IT systems and business processes, which aligns closely with her current profile.
jobs.gap: Retail systems experience is preferred rather than required. Audrey should position her enterprise Salesforce work as evidence that she can learn a new business domain quickly.

jobs.title: Process Management Associate, Provider Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY (Hybrid; 3 days/week in office)
jobs.why: Strong process-improvement match. The job centers on mapping and analyzing business processes, identifying inefficiencies, developing improvements, documenting workflows, facilitating cross-functional work, measuring outcomes, and partnering with Technology, Product, and Engineering on automation opportunities.
jobs.gap: Healthcare/provider operations is a new domain, and Lean Six Sigma certification is a bonus. Audrey should lead with Visio process mapping, measurable Salesforce automation savings, UAT, cross-functional delivery, and operational reporting.

jobs.title: Senior Process Improvement Analyst
jobs.why: Excellent transformation fit: current/future-state process mapping, stakeholder interviews, business rules, user stories, process redesign, automation, AI-enabled workflows, testing, training, and adoption. The posting specifically targets candidates with 2-4 years in business analysis, operations, transformation, or process improvement.
jobs.gap: Broadridge is finance/fintech-adjacent, which is not Audrey's preferred industry. Executive-ready presentation materials and formal continuous-improvement methods are also more prominent here than on her resume.

jobs.title: CRM & Client Development Analyst
jobs.why: A strong CRM pivot that uses Audrey's Salesforce, data-quality, reporting, training, stakeholder-management, and analytics background. Her earlier media-strategy experience also supports the campaign-performance and customer-insight side of the role.
jobs.gap: The role prefers direct CRM, digital marketing, or luxury-retail experience and exposure to Looker or SAP. Audrey should emphasize Salesforce data integrity, reporting, user enablement, and campaign/KPI analysis without overstating CRM marketing ownership.

jobs.title: Product Strategy and Operations Analyst, Google Education
jobs.location: New York, NY (also listed in other US locations)
jobs.why: A worthwhile stretch based on Audrey's cross-functional project delivery, analytics, change management, process improvement, stakeholder communication, and experience turning operational needs into structured system improvements. The education mission also broadens the search beyond traditional corporate BA roles.
jobs.gap: This is the biggest stretch in the set: Google asks for 4 years in management consulting, product management/strategy, or analytics in a technology company. Audrey has transferable experience but should not frame herself as having direct product-strategy tenure.
